data.name: Shokit
data.gender_notes: Shokit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shiva', meaning 'the supreme god in Hinduism, the god of destruction and regeneration'. Shokit is a powerful name for a boy, symbolizing strength, courage, and resilience. It is believed that those named Shokit are blessed with the power and strength of Lord Shiva. The name Shokit carries the meaning “Lord of Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Shokit usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality, Shokit represents the divine power of Lord Shiva. It is believed that those named Shokit have a strong spiritual connection to the divine and are blessed with the qualities of courage, strength, and resilience.
data.etymology: Shokit belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Shiva.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shokit total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
